raw: {"verdict": "warn", "note": "Changing EVAL_SHARD from 7 to 13 edits the fixed evaluation and points it at shard 13, which is included in TRAIN_SHARDS ('0-6,8-13'), so val_bpb would be measured on training data and no longer reflect real model quality."}

parsed.note: Changing EVAL_SHARD from 7 to 13 edits the fixed evaluation and points it at shard 13, which is included in TRAIN_SHARDS ('0-6,8-13'), so val_bpb would be measured on training data and no longer reflect real model quality.
